Discomfort admission ka paisa hai.
Tum khud ko limit mat karo.
"Tumhari habits future decide karegi."
"Tumhari thoughts reality banati."
Success se zyada failure se learn hota.
Agar jo chahiye kabhi nahi tha, toh jo kabhi nahi kiya—wo karo.
Tum kabhi bhi old nahi hote, goal set karne ke liye.
Nazar taaron par, aur pair zameen par rakho.
Failure se failure tak ka safar, bina josh khoe.
"Par jo bhi karo, aage badhna hai."
Agar matter kare, tum raasta nikaaloge.
